background.$description: Generic yellow surface. Use for application-defined meaning — charts, categories, states with no semantic token. Pair with content-on-yellow.

background-subtle.$description: Subtle generic yellow surface. Use behind content-yellow, optionally outlined with border-yellow-subtle.

border.$description: Generic yellow border. Use for application-defined meaning where no semantic token applies.

border-subtle.$description: Subtle generic yellow border. Pairs with bg-yellow-subtle.

content.$description: Generic yellow text and icons on a default surface. Also legible on bg-yellow-subtle.

content-on-color.$description: Generic yellow text and icons for use on a dark or strongly coloured surface. The mode-swapped counterpart of content-yellow.

on-background.$description: Text and icons drawn on top of bg-yellow. Chosen per hue for contrast — do not substitute a fixed neutral.
